name: DexYCB
tagline: 582K RGB-D frames of 10 subjects grasping 20 YCB objects from 8 synchronized cameras, with 3D hand and 6-DoF object pose on every frame.

annotations.format: NPZ label files per frame (seg, pose_y, pose_m, joint_3d, joint_2d) + YAML/JSON metadata
annotations.coverageNote: All 582K frames (1,000 sequences x 8 cameras) carry hand/object segmentation, MANO hand pose and 6-DoF YCB object poses.

action_labels.note: Sequences are single grasp trials; no verb/noun labels

object_boxes.note: 2D boxes derived from masks for the COCO-style detection benchmark

segmentation.note: Per-pixel map: background, 21 YCB object ids, hand (255)

hand_pose.note: MANO PCA pose + 21 3D/2D joints per frame

object_pose.note: 6-DoF [R|t] for every present YCB object; CAD models shipped

camera_pose.note: Factory intrinsics + extrinsics for all 8 Azure Kinect cameras

depth.note: Aligned depth PNG per RGB frame (Azure Kinect)

samples.caption: Ground-truth hand and YCB object poses rendered on one camera view
CVPR 2021 presentation video of the DexYCB benchmark
